ops.offline: No network connection. What you entered is kept; try again once you are online.
ops.error.network: Not sent: the connection dropped. Check the network and try again.
ops.error.notAllowed: You are not allowed to do this at this store.
ops.error.session: Your sign-in expired. The app is reconnecting.
ops.error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a few minutes.
ops.noPersonalDetails: Do not write personal details such as phone numbers, ID numbers or anyone's private matters.
ops.photo.refused: The camera is not allowed, so this item stays open. You can still do the other items; when ready, allow the camera in Zalo and tap Take a photo.
ops.photo.unreadable: This photo could not be read. Take it again.
ops.photo.noBucket: This store has no photo storage yet. Tell your manager.
ops.photo.title: Proof photo
ops.photo.loadFailed: The photo could not be loaded.
ops.photo.removed: The photo was removed after the retention period.

shift.subtitle: {store} · {date}
shift.closeBody: Count the cash in the drawer, then write a handover for the next shift.
checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.none: This store has no checklists yet.
checklist.otherOpen: Someone else is doing this checklist
checklist.otherHint: One person does each round. You can see the progress but not tick items for them.
checklist.subtitle: {phase} · {date} · version {version}
checklist.photoPurpose: The camera opens only when you tap Take a photo; the photo lets your manager confirm the task.
checklist.block.photo: Take a photo before marking this done.
checklist.block.number: Enter the reading before marking this done.
checklist.block.number-invalid: The reading is not a number. Enter for example 4 or 4.5.
checklist.error.check: This item needs a photo or a reading before it is done.
checklist.error.finished: The checklist is finished and can no longer change.
checklist.error.photo: The photo is not in this round's storage. Take it again.
checklist.error.taken: Someone else is doing this checklist today. You can see the progress under Shifts.
checklist.error.retired: This checklist is no longer used.
checklist.readOnly: The checklist is finished, so it is read-only.
checklist.confirmBody: {left} tasks are not ticked. After finishing you cannot change them.
close.title: Close the shift
close.problem.empty: Enter the number of notes per value, or the total.
close.problem.invalid: The total takes digits only, for example 2,350,000.
close.problem.note: The note is longer than 500 characters.
close.confirmHint: Once confirmed, the count cannot change; if it is wrong, a manager reopens it for a recount.
close.replacesHint: This count replaces the one a manager reopened.
close.error.check: The amount is not valid. Check the number of notes.
close.error.replaced: The count to replace is no longer open. Ask your manager.
close.recountBody: A manager reopened the count made at {time}. This count replaces it.
close.waitingForShift: The count is matched to its shift once the shift's data arrives from the POS.
close.unmatched: Not matched to a shift yet
close.noReference: The POS has no cash amount for the shift
close.note.empty: Write the handover, or choose Skip the handover.
close.note.long: The handover is longer than 2,000 characters.
close.note.control: The note contains characters that are not allowed.
cash.none: No shifts in the last two days.
cash.countOn: Count not matched to a shift · {date}
cash.reopenBody: This count stays in the history. Staff count again under Close the shift, and the new count replaces this one.

report.problem.description-control: The description contains characters that are not allowed.
